title: Formalizing the Intrinsic Dimension of Objective Landscapes by a Generalized Notion of Co-dimension
abstract: arXiv:2610.39674v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this work, we formalize the concept of intrinsic dimension of objective landscapes introduced in Li et al. (2018), which measures the structural complexity of learning problems by training along randomly generated subspaces. We define the intrinsic dimension of a set $\Theta\subset\mathbb{R}^p$ as the minimal dimension $d_{\mathrm{int}}(\Theta)$ such that a random plane of dimension $d_{\mathrm{int}}(\Theta)$ in $\mathbb{R}^p$ intersects $\Theta$ with probability one. We show that it is a generalized notion of co-dimension that depends on the global geometry of $\Theta$. We study mathematical properties of the intrinsic dimension and develop techniques to estimate the intrinsic dimension of sets $\Theta$ that arise in learning problems. translated_title: 通过广义余维数概念形式化目标景观的内在维度
translated_abstract: 在本工作中，我们形式化了Li等人（2018）提出的目标景观内在维度的概念，该概念通过沿随机生成的子空间进行训练来衡量学习问题的结构复杂度。我们将集合Θ⊂ℝ^p的内在维度定义为最小维度d_int(Θ)，使得ℝ^p中维度为d_int(Θ)的随机平面以概率一与Θ相交。我们证明它是一种依赖于Θ的全局几何的广义余维数概念。我们研究了内在维度的数学性质，并开发了估计学习问题中出现的集合Θ的内在维度的技术。更具体地说，我们推导了当Θ是学生-教师设置中浅层和深层ReLU网络最优参数集合时的上界和/或下界，包括有限和无限……
tldr: 本文将目标景观的内在维度形式化为一种依赖于集合全局几何的广义余维数概念，并为浅层和深层ReLU网络学生-教师设置中的最优参数集合推导出内在维度的上下界。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the intrinsic dimension of objective landscapes as a generalized notion of co-dimension that depends on the global geometry of the set, and derives upper and/or lower bounds for the intrinsic dimension of optimal parameter sets in student-teacher settings with shallow and deep ReLU networks.
